card.name: Digits inside citation numbers and names
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit (often 4 or 8) in the middle of journal page numbers, DOIs and ISBNs in reference lists. Also fires on a few scattered words such as hyphen parts of double surnames and 'methods' after 'these'.
